annotations.title: Cut a text down to the lines that say something

description: Returns the gist of a text: drops sentences that are pure filler, buzzwords, pleasantries or repeats, and trims padding phrases ("in order to" becomes "to", "it's important to note that" is removed) from the rest. Keeps the author's own words and order, invents nothing. Also returns the fluff percentage and how many words were cut.

text.description: The text to cut down (up to 60,000 characters).

name: fluff_gist_text
title: Cut a text down to the lines that say something
